decision.reasoning_trace: In my search for a backpack, I evaluated a mix of budget-friendly daypacks (SHENHU, KAUKKO), specialized hiking gear (High Sierra, Osprey), and everyday carry (EDC) options. I narrowed my consideration set to these five because they represent the best diversity in price and function. Ultimately, I chose the Maxpedition Prepared Citizen Classic v2.0. It offers a professional, non-tactical aesthetic with high-quality construction and excellent ratings for durability and comfort, making it the most versatile choice for both daily commuting and light travel compared to the more specialized hiking packs.
